draft.summary: Write the counter-staff instructions for the order status page
draft.description:
## Context
Proposed owner (from the meeting): Laura Peña.

Phase: 1.

Counter staff will update order statuses. Laura Peña will write their instructions once the status page exists.

## Objective and Deliverable
Written instructions for counter staff on moving an order through Received, In the oven, Ready for pickup and Delivered with one tap.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Instructions available** (Happy path) — The order status page is available to counter staff. Expected: written instructions explain how to move an order through Received, In the oven, Ready for pickup and Delivered.

## References, Risks and Dependencies
Depends on the order status page story.
